messages:
Omar S.: Hey @people-ops, heads-up — my spouse's passport expired and our consulate visa appointment got pushed to next month. Do I need to change my start date or any benefits paperwork?
Maria HR: hi Omar — sorry to hear that. Can you share the new projected start date and whether this affects entry to the country?
Omar S.: New consulate slot is Apr 28, prob earliest re-entry May 5. My offer start is Apr 15. I can work remotely for a few weeks if that helps.
Rebecca L.: @Maria HR we usually allow a deferred start for visa delays; remote work is ok for up to 30 days pre-approved. Need manager sign-off + update to hiring ops.
Maria HR: correct. Omar, we also need to adjust your benefits enrollment window. If your start shifts past Apr 30, benefits eligibility date may move. Can you confirm final start once stamping done?
Omar S.: will confirm by Apr 10 after consulate confirmation. If I start remote Apr 15, do I still get benefits effective Apr 15?
Alyssa (Immigration): quick note from immigration side — passport & visa stamping are tied to re-entry. If you remain outside the country on Apr 15, your I-9 and in-person verification will need to be done within 3 business days of arrival per policy, or we can use E-Verify exceptions? pinging people-ops for policy.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: please attach visa docs to the HR case file at https://redwood/hr/cases/omars-visa when available.
Maria HR: If you start remote and are employed (payroll onboarded) on Apr 15, benefits can be effective then, but we need signed forms completed electronically. If you delay start until after re-entry, benefits effective date shifts to that new start.
Rebecca L.: Manager sign-off received (Slack DM). Omar, I'll open a hiring-ops change request to toggle remote start and note payroll/benefits impact.
Omar S.: thanks, appreciate it. I'll upload the passport renewal receipt and consulate confirmation once booked.
Alyssa (Immigration): Also check dependent coverage for health — if spouse's status changes temporarily, benefits eligibility for dependents may lag; Maria can confirm timeline.
Maria HR: noted — we'll flag dependent coverage as contingent. Omar, once you upload docs we'll set the temporary allowance and confirm COBRA/coverage options if needed.
Omar S.: sounds good. One last Q: does payroll need a new I-9 copy or SSN update after re-entry?
Rebecca L.: If SSN stays same, no action. If you get an updated SSN or name change, send docs to payroll@redwood.com. I-9 is verified at physical location post-entry if you were onboarded remotely.
Omar S.: perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Maria HR: keeping this thread for audit trail. Please update the HR case and tag me when docs are uploaded.
people-ops-bot: Ticket created: HR-2026-5497 for Omar S. (visa/start-date change).
